description: This file defines the ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface and is responsible for configuring menu items related to reporting methods within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It uses traits and classes related to menu and screen management.

classes.name: ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for reporting methods, overriding the current screen's view to 'viewReportingMethods'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewReportingMethods' using a helper method.
